decided_and_not_reopened.ship_model: Ticket ref, dated 2026-08-22: local -> primary (canonical) -> mirror -> secondary runs distribution only. Release creation is the release handler on primary via tag push.
decided_and_not_reopened.layer_boundary: Two cross-cutting concerns: generic mechanics in the shared templates (engine, agent-test, suite-test); business logic in the operator layover; configuration optionally per repository.
decided_and_not_reopened.effort_unit: complexity points in a fixed sequence, no time estimates. The template asset's estimated field is stale against practice; practice wins.
decided_and_not_reopened.dispatch_path: Operator decision 2026-08-23: the dispatch flow follows the standard model without exception. The measured state (an older producer, no primary producer, mirror being written to) is a divergence to be corrected, not a benchmark to copy. One dispatch removes secondary-side production; another supplies the engine configuration in the operator repository.
decided_and_not_reopened.pipeline_model: Operator, 2026-08-23: the model 'local -> primary (canonical) -> mirror -> secondary distribution only' applies to effectively every repository. Exactly two exceptions: secondary-only repositories with no primary canonical (e.g. a profile repository), and distribution artefacts the primary host cannot build, produced on the secondary side after the mirror. The second is an exception about the build environment, never about where the release object is created. Written down in a document, given reach and an instrument by a later ticket. Not to be re-litigated per repository.
